stem: If you _____ too much sugar, your blood pressure _____.
explanation_tr: Zero Conditional genel gecerli gercekleri ifade eder. Her iki tarafta da Present Simple kullanilir: If + Present Simple, Present Simple.
rule_tr: Zero Conditional: If + Present Simple, Present Simple (bilimsel gercek, her zaman dogru olan seyler)
tip_tr: Her zaman dogru olan bir sey anlatiliyorsa (bilimsel gercek, genel kural) = Zero Conditional.
extra_example: If you heat water to 100°C, it boils. (Suyu 100°C'ye isitirsan kaynar.)

stem: If a patient _____ an allergic reaction, the nurse immediately _____ the doctor.
explanation_tr: Bu bir hastane protokolu, yani her zaman gecerli bir kural. Zero Conditional: If + Present Simple, Present Simple.
rule_tr: Zero Conditional: Kurallar, protokoller, rutinler icin de kullanilir.
tip_tr: Hastane kurallari, is prosedürleri gibi her zaman uygulanan kurallar = Zero Conditional.
extra_example: If the temperature exceeds 38°C, the patient takes paracetamol. (Ates 38°C'yi asarsa hasta parasetamol alir.)

stem: If you _____ your medication regularly, you _____ better soon.
explanation_tr: Gercekci ve olasi bir gelecek durumu anlatiliyor. First Conditional: If + Present Simple, will + V1.
rule_tr: First Conditional: If + Present Simple, will + V1 (gercekci, olasi gelecek durumlar)
tip_tr: Gerceklesmesi muhtemel bir durum = First Conditional. If clause'da ASLA will kullanma.
extra_example: If you don't stop smoking, you will develop lung problems. (Sigarayi birakmazsan akciger sorunlari yasayacaksin.)

stem: If the test results _____ positive, the doctor _____ further examinations.
explanation_tr: Test sonuclarinin pozitif cikmasi olasi bir durum. If + Present Simple (are), will + V1 (will order). First Conditional.
rule_tr: First Conditional: If + Present Simple, will + V1
tip_tr: If clause'da 'are' (Present Simple) gorursen ve durum gercekci ise, ana cumlede 'will' bekle.
extra_example: If the patient feels dizzy, she will need to lie down. (Hasta bas donmesi hissederse uzanmasi gerekecek.)

stem: The nurse _____ you if you _____ the call button.
explanation_tr: Cumlede if clause sonda. Sirasi fark etmez: will + V1 (will help), if + Present Simple (press). If clause'da will KULLANILMAZ.
rule_tr: First Conditional ters sira: Main clause (will + V1) + if + Present Simple
tip_tr: If clause basta da sonda da olabilir. Onemli olan: if'den sonra ASLA will koymamak.
extra_example: You will recover faster if you follow the doctor's advice. (Doktorun tavsiyesine uyarsan daha hizli iyilesirsin.)

stem: If I _____ a doctor, I _____ in a hospital.
explanation_tr: Gercek olmayan hayali bir durum (doktor degilim ama olsaydim). Second Conditional: If + Past Simple, would + V1. 'Be' fiili icin tum oznerelerde 'were' kullanilir.
rule_tr: Second Conditional: If + Past Simple (were), would + V1 (hayali, gercek olmayan durumlar)
tip_tr: Second Conditional'da 'be' fiili her zaman 'were' olur: If I were, If he were, If she were.
extra_example: If she were a nurse, she would take care of patients every day. (Hemsire olsaydi her gun hastalara bakardi.)

stem: If the hospital _____ more staff, patients _____ wait so long.
explanation_tr: Hastane su anda yeterli personel almiyor (gercek olmayan durum). If + Past Simple (hired), wouldn't + V1 (wouldn't wait). Second Conditional.
rule_tr: Second Conditional olumsuz: If + V2, wouldn't + V1
tip_tr: Su anda gercek olmayan ama 'olsa ne guzel olurdu' dedigimiz durumlar = Second Conditional.
extra_example: If there were more hospitals, people wouldn't travel so far for treatment. (Daha fazla hastane olsaydi insanlar tedavi icin bu kadar uzaga gitmezdi.)

stem: If you _____ water, you _____.
explanation_tr: Su icmezsen dehidrate olursun — bu her zaman gecerli bilimsel bir gercek. Zero Conditional: If + Present Simple, Present Simple.
rule_tr: Zero Conditional olumsuz: If + don't/doesn't + V1, Present Simple
tip_tr: Bilimsel/tibbi bir gercek mi? Evet = Zero Conditional. Hayir, sadece olasi bir durum mu? = First Conditional.
extra_example: If you don't sleep enough, your immune system weakens. (Yeterince uyumazsan bagisiklik sistemin zayiflar.)

stem: If the ambulance _____ on time, the patient's life _____ in danger.
explanation_tr: Ambulansin zamaninda gelmemesi gercek bir olasilik. If + Present Simple (doesn't arrive), will + V1 (will be). First Conditional.
rule_tr: First Conditional olumsuz: If + don't/doesn't + V1, will + V1
tip_tr: Olumsuz First Conditional: If + don't/doesn't (ASLA won't degil!) + V1, will...
extra_example: If you don't wear a mask, you will increase the risk of infection. (Maske takmazsan enfeksiyon riskini arttiracaksin.)

stem: What _____ you do if you _____ a doctor in a remote village?
explanation_tr: Hayali bir soru soruluyor: 'Uzak bir koyde doktor olsan ne yapardin?' Second Conditional soru: What would + S + V1 + if + S + V2/were?
rule_tr: Second Conditional soru: What/Where/How + would + S + V1 + if + S + V2/were?
tip_tr: Hayali soru sorarken: What would you do if...? Ne yapardin eger...?
extra_example: What would you do if you found a cure for cancer? (Kanserin tedavisini bulsan ne yapardin?)

stem: If the government _____ more in healthcare, fewer people _____ from preventable diseases.
explanation_tr: Hukumet su anda yeterince yatirim yapmiyor (gercek olmayan varsayim). If + Past Simple (invested), would + V1 (would die). Second Conditional.
rule_tr: Second Conditional: su anki gercekligin tersini hayal etme. If + V2, would + V1.
tip_tr: Gercek durumun tersini hayal ediyorsan Second Conditional kullan: 'yapmiyor ama yapsa...'
extra_example: If the hospital had better equipment, doctors would perform more complex surgeries. (Hastanenin daha iyi ekipmani olsa doktorlar daha karmasik ameliyatlar yapardi.)

stem: If the doctor _____ the correct diagnosis earlier, the patient _____ recovered.
explanation_tr: Gecmiste gerceklesmeyen bir durum: doktor dogru tanisi erken koymadi (ama koysaydi). Third Conditional: If + had + V3, would have + V3.
rule_tr: Third Conditional: If + had + V3, would/could/might have + V3 (gecmiste degistirilemeyen pismanlık/varsayim)
tip_tr: Gecmiste olan ve degistirilemeyen durumlar = Third Conditional. 'Keske...olsaydi' anlamı.
extra_example: If the nurse had noticed the symptoms, she would have alerted the doctor. (Hemsire belirtileri fark etseydi doktoru uyarirdi.)

stem: The surgery _____ successful if the team _____ better preparation.
explanation_tr: Ameliyat basarili olmadi ve ekip daha iyi hazirlanmamisti (gecmiste degistirilemeyen durum). Ana cumle: would have been + if + had had (Past Perfect).
rule_tr: Third Conditional ters sira: would have + V3 + if + had + V3
tip_tr: had had = had (Past Perfect yardimci fiil) + had (have fiilinin V3 formu). Garip gorunur ama dogrudur.
extra_example: The patient would have survived if the ambulance had arrived five minutes earlier. (Ambulans bes dakika erken gelseydi hasta hayatta kalirdi.)

stem: Unless the patient _____ the prescribed diet, his cholesterol levels _____.
explanation_tr: 'Unless' = 'If not' anlamina gelir. 'Unless the patient follows' = 'If the patient doesn't follow'. Unless'tan sonra OLUMLU cumle gelir.
rule_tr: Unless = If not. Unless + olumlu fiil, will/won't + V1. Unless'tan sonra olumsuz fiil KULLANILMAZ.
tip_tr: Unless = eger ...mazsa. Unless + olumlu cumle. YANLIS: Unless he doesn't come. DOGRU: Unless he comes.
extra_example: Unless you take the antibiotic for the full course, the infection won't clear. (Antibiyotigi tam kur boyunca almazsan enfeksiyon gecmez.)

stem: I wish I _____ a doctor so that I could help people in need.
explanation_tr: I wish + Past Simple: su anki gercekligin tersini dilemek. 'Be' fiili icin wish'ten sonra tum oznelerde 'were' kullanilir (formal).
rule_tr: I wish + Past Simple (were): su anki hayali dilek. 'Keske ...olsam' anlami.
tip_tr: wish + were (tum ozneler icin). I wish I were, I wish he were, I wish she were.
extra_example: She wishes she were taller. (Keske daha uzun olsa.)

stem: The nurse wishes she _____ more time to spend with each patient.
explanation_tr: Hemsirenin su anda yeterli zamani yok ama olmasini diliyor. I wish + Past Simple: su anki durumun tersini dilemek.
rule_tr: wish + V2 (Past Simple): su anki durumdan memnuniyetsizlik, 'keske' anlami
tip_tr: wish + had = keske olsa (su anki dilek). wish + had had = keske olsaydi (gecmis dilek).
extra_example: I wish I had more experience in emergency medicine. (Keske acil tipla ilgili daha fazla deneyimim olsa.)

stem: If I _____ allergic to penicillin, I _____ it yesterday without any problems.
explanation_tr: Mixed Conditional: Su anki durum (penisiline alerjim var — devam eden) gecmisteki eylemi etkiliyor (dun alabilirdim). If + Past Simple (weren't — su anki durum), would have + V3 (would have taken — gecmis sonuc).
rule_tr: Mixed Conditional Tip 1: If + Past Simple (su anki durum), would have + V3 (gecmis sonuc)
tip_tr: Su anki durum + gecmis sonuc = Mixed Conditional. if clause su anki hayali durum, sonuc gecmiste.
extra_example: If I spoke French, I would have applied for the position in Paris. (Fransizca bilseydim Paris'teki pozisyona basvururdum.)

stem: Provided that the patient _____ to the treatment, the doctor _____ him next week.
explanation_tr: 'Provided that' = 'if' anlami tasir (sart kosarak). First Conditional yapisiyla kullanilir: provided that + Present Simple, will + V1.
rule_tr: provided that / as long as / on condition that = if yerine kullanilabilir. Ayni kurallar gecerli.
tip_tr: provided that, as long as, on condition that gibi ifadeler 'if' ile ayni kurallara uyar.
extra_example: As long as you rest properly, you will make a full recovery. (Duzgun dinlendigin surece tam olarak iyileseceksin.)

stem: If every country _____ equal access to vaccines, millions of lives _____ saved each year.
explanation_tr: Her ulkenin esit asi erisimi yok (gercek olmayan durum). If + Past Simple (had), would + V1 (would be saved). Second Conditional.
rule_tr: Second Conditional Passive: If + V2, would + be + V3
tip_tr: Second Conditional'da pasif yapi: would be + V3. Gercek olmayan hayali sonuc pasif olabilir.
extra_example: If more money were allocated to research, new cures would be discovered. (Arastirmaya daha fazla para ayrilsa yeni tedaviler kesfedilirdi.)

stem: I wish the hospital _____ overcrowded. There are too many patients.
explanation_tr: Hastane su anda kalabalik (gercek) ama konusmaci bunun boyle olmamasini diliyor. I wish + Past Simple. 'Be' fiili icin 'weren't' kullanilir.
rule_tr: I wish + weren't/didn't: su anki olumsuz dilegin ifadesi
tip_tr: wish'ten sonra olumsuz istek: wish + weren't (be fiili) veya wish + didn't + V1 (diger fiiller).
extra_example: I wish my medication didn't have so many side effects. (Keske ilacimin bu kadar cok yan etkisi olmasa.)

stem: Had the paramedics _____ the bleeding sooner, the patient's condition _____ less critical.
explanation_tr: 'Had the paramedics stopped' = 'If the paramedics had stopped' seklinde if'siz (inverted) Third Conditional. Had + S + V3, would have + V3.
rule_tr: Inverted Third Conditional: Had + S + V3, S + would have + V3 (if olmadan, resmi dil)
tip_tr: Had + ozne ile baslayan cumle = If'siz Third Conditional. Resmi ve akademik dilde sik kullanilir.
extra_example: Had the doctor prescribed the right medication, the patient would have recovered faster. (Doktor dogru ilaci yazsaydi hasta daha hizli iyilesirdi.)

stem: If the hospital _____ the new hygiene protocols last year, the infection rate _____.
explanation_tr: 'Last year' gecmis zamani gosteriyor. Hastane protokolleri gecen yil uygulamadi (gerceklesmeyen gecmis). If + had + V3, would have + V3. Third Conditional.
rule_tr: Third Conditional: If + had + V3, would have + V3. 'Last year' gecmisi dogruluyor.
tip_tr: Gecmis zaman zarfi (last year, yesterday, in 2020) + hayali durum = kesinlikle Third Conditional.
extra_example: If they had quarantined the area earlier, the outbreak would have been contained. (Bolgeyi daha erken karantinaya alsalardi salgini kontrol altina alabilirlerdi.)

stem: If she _____ medicine at university, she _____ a qualified doctor now.
explanation_tr: Mixed Conditional Tip 2: Gecmisteki eylem (universitede tip okumadi — had studied) su anki durumu etkiliyor (simdi doktor olurdu — would be). If + had + V3 (gecmis), would + V1 (su anki sonuc).
rule_tr: Mixed Conditional Tip 2: If + had + V3 (gecmis kosul), would + V1 (su anki sonuc). 'now' ipucu.
tip_tr: If + had V3 + now/today = Mixed Conditional. Gecmis kosul ama su anki sonuc.
extra_example: If I had taken the job in London, I would be living there now. (Londra'daki isi kabul etseydim simdi orada yasiyor olurdum.)

stem: If the nurse _____ more careful, she _____ the wrong dosage to the patient yesterday.
explanation_tr: Mixed Conditional Tip 1: Su anki genel ozellik (hemsire dikkatli degil — were) gecmisteki olaya neden oldu (dun yanlis doz verdi — wouldn't have given). If + were, would have + V3.
rule_tr: Mixed Conditional Tip 1: If + were/V2 (su anki ozellik), would have + V3 (gecmis sonuc). 'yesterday' ipucu.
tip_tr: If + were/V2 + yesterday/last week = Mixed. Su anki kisilik/ozellik gecmisi etkilemis.
extra_example: If he weren't so forgetful, he wouldn't have missed his appointment last week. (Bu kadar unutkan olmasa gecen haftaki randevusunu kacirmazdi.)

stem: The patient wishes he _____ smoking years ago. Now he has serious lung problems.
explanation_tr: Hasta gecmiste sigarayi birakmadi ve simdi pisman. Gecmis pismanlık icin: wish + had + V3 (Past Perfect). 'Years ago' gecmisi isaret ediyor.
rule_tr: wish + had + V3: gecmis pisman. 'Keske ...yapsaydim' anlami.
tip_tr: wish + V2 = su anki dilek | wish + had V3 = gecmis pisman | wish + would = gelecek sikayet/istek
extra_example: I wish I had studied harder for the medical exam. (Keske tip sinavina daha cok calisseydim.)

stem: I wish the government _____ something about the shortage of nurses in rural areas.
explanation_tr: Konusmaci hukumetin bir sey yapmasini istiyor (sikayet/istek). wish + would: baskalarindan beklenen davranis degisikligi, sikayet veya ricalar icin kullanilir.
rule_tr: wish + would + V1: baskasinin davranisini degistirmesini istemek, sikayet, rica
tip_tr: wish + would: 'Keske su adam sunu yapsa!' anlaminda sikayet/istek. Kendi icin KULLANILMAZ (I wish I would = YANLIS).
extra_example: I wish the hospital would improve its waiting room facilities. (Keske hastane bekleme odasi olanaklarini iyilestirse.)

stem: Should the patient's condition _____, call me immediately.
explanation_tr: 'Should + S + V1' yapisi 'If + S + V1' in formal (resmi) versiyonudur. Should the patient's condition worsen = If the patient's condition worsens. Should'dan sonra yalin fiil (V1) gelir.
rule_tr: Inverted First Conditional: Should + S + V1, imperative/will. Resmi ve tibbi dilde yaygin.
tip_tr: Should + ozne = If'siz First Conditional. Tibbi metinlerde ve resmi yazilarda cok kullanilir.
extra_example: Should you experience any side effects, contact your doctor. (Herhangi bir yan etki yasarsaniz doktorunuza basvurun.)

stem: If a person's blood oxygen level _____ below 90%, it _____ a medical emergency.
explanation_tr: Bu tibbi bir gercek/protokol: oksijen seviyesi %90'in altina duserse her zaman tibbi acil durum olusturur. Genel gecerli gercek = Zero Conditional: If + Present Simple, Present Simple.
rule_tr: Zero Conditional: tibbi gercekler, protokoller, bilimsel yasalar = If + Present Simple, Present Simple
tip_tr: Tipta, bilimde, mühendislikte gecerli kurallar Zero Conditional ile ifade edilir.
extra_example: If the pH of blood falls below 7.35, the condition is called acidosis. (Kanin pH'i 7.35'in altina duserse bu duruma asidoz denir.)

stem: The epidemic _____ contained if the authorities _____ travel restrictions in time.
explanation_tr: Gecmiste yetkililer seyahat kisitlamasini zamaninda uygulamadi ve salgini kontrol altina alamadi. Could have been + V3 (gecmis olasilik) + if + had + V3. Third Conditional.
rule_tr: Third Conditional: could/might have + V3 de kullanilabilir (would yerine). Olasilik derecesini degistirir.
tip_tr: would have = kesin olurdu | could have = olabilirdi | might have = belki olurdu. Hepsi Third Conditional'da gecerli.
extra_example: The patient might have survived if the diagnosis had been made earlier. (Tani daha erken konulsaydi hasta belki hayatta kalabilirdi.)

stem: If modern medicine _____ so advanced, we _____ able to treat this disease when it emerged in the 1990s.
explanation_tr: Su anki genel durum (modern tip cok gelismis — weren't) gecmisteki sonucu etkiliyor (1990'larda tedavi edebildik — wouldn't have been). If + weren't (su anki durum), wouldn't have been (gecmis sonuc). Mixed Conditional.
rule_tr: Mixed Conditional: If + weren't/V2 (su anki kosul), would(n't) have + V3 (gecmis sonuc)
tip_tr: Su anki genel ozellik/durum + gecmis sonuc (in the 1990s, yesterday, last year) = Mixed Conditional.
extra_example: If technology weren't so advanced, doctors wouldn't have performed that groundbreaking surgery last year. (Teknoloji bu kadar gelismis olmasa doktorlar gecen yil o ciginir ameliyati yapamazdi.)
